text:
sofia: heads-up — publish for the sample-sdk failed the release gate. regen diff is only a tuple canonicalization change but semver-check flagged a minor.
ci-bot: job #6001 failed at release: https://ci.example.com/6001 (exit 1)
marc: minimal diff:```diff
- export type Pair = [string, number?]
+ export type Pair = readonly [string, number?]
```semver tool treats readonly tuple as surface change.
leo: typegen v4.2.0 started emitting readonly tuples by default (opt-in turned on accidentally). this is a pure regen cosmetic change.
sofia: also seeing sample-app onboarding e2e flakes: auth retry mutates an in-memory counter so second attempt yields different payload and tests sometimes fail, which blocks the gated publish.
marc: quick plan: (1) add a normalization pass that strips readonly<> and readonly tuple wrappers for semver diffing, (2) add CI gate that labels PRs with only generated/ changes as "regen-only", (3) fix test harness to deep-clone retry payloads.
leo: I'll roll a tiny typegen revert/pin in release CI to unblock the immediate publish. then open a PR to change default to false.
marc: I'll implement normalize-for-semv.js that canonicalizes tuples and removes readonly for the semver step.
sofia: I'll take the test harness fix and make retry idempotent (structuredClone before retry).
devex-bot: created issue #1299 "tuple canonicalization -> regen-only minor release" and attached CI logs.
changelog-bot: noted: will skip auto-minor for PRs labeled "regen-only" after CI gate.
sofia: thanks — once the three changes land we'll run a canary publish to staging and then unpin.
